definition: H Company, also known simply as H, is a French artificial intelligence startup which develops "action-oriented" artificial intelligence agents for enterprise automation and productivity.
details: In May 2024, H Company closed a record-setting $220 million seed round, at the time the largest AI raise in Europe. In 2026, H Company released Holo 3, the latest generation of its computer-use AI models. The update marked a major advance in agentic AI, enabling agents to navigate any user interface, interpret screens, and complete complex, multi-step tasks across enterprise systems—much like a human user.

explainer.lead: H Company is a French artificial intelligence startup building agents that carry out work on computers, rather than only generating text or answers. Its technology is aimed at automating multi-step tasks across enterprise software.

tiers.eli5: It makes AI helpers that use computer screens and menus like a person would to get office tasks done.
tiers.practitioner: Enterprises deploy its computer-use models to navigate interfaces and interpret screens for multi-step workflows; a pitfall is expecting reliability across arbitrary enterprise systems without testing the agent on each interface.
tiers.paperLevel: Computer-use AI models that navigate any user interface, interpret screens, and complete complex multi-step tasks across enterprise systems much like a human user. Known limits: the given facts do not state benchmark scores or failure rates.
